notes: Biamp Parlé TCM-X is a two-part AVB Beamtracking ceiling-microphone system for Tesira systems: a 16-element digital-array ceiling capsule (5.9in/150mm diameter) plus a plenum/network box that mounts above the ceiling tile. All 3 physical connectors are RJ-45 on the network/plenum box (front-panel labels confirmed via Biamp's Oct-2025 Installation & Operation Guide, Figure 1: "AVB / Control", "Mic 1", "Mic 2"). Power is PoE only (IEEE 802.3at Type 1 Class 3, 15.4W) delivered through the AVB/Control port, so no discrete power connector exists. Mic 1/Mic 2 use a custom/proprietary digital protocol (not standard network audio) to the captive-cabled mic capsule and optional TCM-XEX expansion mic; treated as RJ-45/bidirectional per the connector-type convention. No Ethernet link speed (100M/1G/etc.) is stated in any Biamp documentation reviewed, so "grade" was omitted on all RJ-45 ports rather than guessed. Device is plenum/ceiling-mounted (not a rack unit), so rackUnits is omitted. This excludes the amplified sibling TCM-XA (adds 2 more RJ-45 "Amp Out" speaker ports) and the TCM-XEX/TTM-X/TCM-1 family members, which are separate SKUs on the same combined datasheet.

ports.name: AVB / Control
ports.note: Uplink to Tesira AVB/TSN network switch (or PoE+ injector for single-device systems); also carries PoE power in (IEEE 802.3at Type 1 Class 3, 15.4W) — no separate power connector on the unit.

ports.name: Mic 1
ports.note: Proprietary digital connection to the ceiling microphone capsule (captive 2m cable terminates in RJ-45).

ports.name: Mic 2
ports.note: Optional second RJ-45; connects a second ceiling mic capsule or an expansion TCM-XEX microphone. Max 2 mic capsules per network box.
